title: Delivery metrics: throughput, cycle time and DORA

videos.script: A number on a dashboard can do two very different jobs. It can help a team see how its work flows. Or it can watch the people in it. {{jobs}} The same number cannot do both for long. Once a measure becomes a target, people move the measure instead of the work. {{goodhart}} This lesson keeps to the first job. It reads throughput and cycle time as a pair, and checks Little's law on the Agenda team's real board. {{pair}} Then it computes the four DORA metrics from a month of deploys: how often, how fast, how often it breaks, how fast it recovers. {{dora}} And it ends with rules that keep those numbers honest, starting with one: no individual's name on a delivery chart. {{rules}}
